items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/figcaption

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

No response

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

Incorrect description because <figcaption> provides accessible name:

The <figcaption> HTML element represents a caption or legend describing the rest of the contents of its parent <figure> element, providing the <figure> an accessible description.

What did you expect to see?

The <figcaption> HTML element represents a caption or legend describing the rest of the contents of its parent <figure> element, providing the <figure> an accessible name.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

Reference:

  • https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/names-and-descriptions/#naming_with_captions

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
